results.title: Norfolk Island
results.creator_credit: Don Murray, Frank Bagnall and Australian Commonwealth Film Unit
results.brief_description: The tourist attractions of Norfolk Island. Today tourists can fly to Norfolk Island for the scenery and the simplicity of an island holiday amongst volcanic ridges and sub-tropical vegetation where they can enjoy fishing, golfing, surfing and other sports. There are also reminders to be seen of the island’s historic past: ruins of convict buildings and stables, Bloody Bridge, and St. Barnabas Chapel built by the Melanesian Mission.

results.title: Nonverbal communication (TEFC)
results.creator_credit: Harry From, Stanley Milgram and Harper & Row
results.brief_description: Examines scientific findings on communication through gesture, body posture, intonation, eye contact, and facial expression. results.brief_description: A discussion of the problem of teenage drinking and driving. Three college men, one doing no drinking, one drinking beer, and one drinking heavily, are studied. The results are compared to the effects of equivalent amounts of alcohol on rats. Depicts an accident resulting from only casual drinking before driving.

results.title: Nomads of the jungle: Malaya
results.creator_credit: Victor Jurgens and Louis de Rochemont Associates
results.brief_description: The everyday life of a typical nomad family in the jungles of Malaya. In the dense tropical forest this group lives entirely on natural resources without agriculture or husbandry. The film shows how the family group secures and cooks its food, builds shelters, a bridge, and a raft. The film also shows how they adopt to changes in the climate and their environment. The story centres on the development of a boy, the chief’s son, who is approaching maturity, and his preparation for adult responsibilities.
